# Time Management

## Purpose

Turn goals and priorities into a realistic plan that keeps work moving and helps the user finish on time.

## How To Apply This Skill

- Clarify the goal, deadline, available time, and definition of done.
- Break the work into small tasks with concrete outcomes.
- Prioritize tasks by user value, urgency, dependencies, and risk.
- Identify the critical path and complete blocking work early.
- Estimate effort realistically and include time for testing, review, and unexpected issues.
- Separate must-have work from nice-to-have work so scope can be reduced without losing the core outcome.
- Set checkpoints to review progress and adjust the plan when new information appears.
- Keep the next action visible and specific.
- Call out schedule risks early and recommend a practical recovery plan.

## Expected Output

When planning work, provide:

- Goal and deadline
- Definition of done
- Prioritized task list
- Milestones and checkpoints
- Dependencies and critical path
- Effort and time estimates
- Risks and contingency options
- Immediate next action

## Delivery Rules

- Favor a smaller finished scope over a larger unfinished scope.
- Do not hide uncertainty in estimates; state assumptions.
- Reserve time for validation and fixing defects.
- Re-plan when priorities or constraints change.
- End each planning discussion with a clear next step.
